## Scenario

The STAR race of Equal Vote's public US 2024 Presidential poll on BetterVoting (election pres24), 2,772 ballots, 8 candidates. Imported to ask one question: does it matter that 14% of ballots never used both ends of the 0-5 scale? It does not. The scoring leader here is also the Condorcet winner - she beats all seven rivals head to head - so the runoff returns her against any finalist. Blanks are tabulated as 0, exactly as BetterVoting does. Note BetterVoting drops the 7 ballots that score every candidate identically before totalling, so its score column reads 10 points lower for every candidate; no comparison, runoff or winner is affected.
